principle: Lifecycle answers WHERE a mission is. Method profile answers HOW the next bounded work is performed.

supervisor.rule: DMAIC does not force a code change; CONTROL may legitimately conclude HOLD, RETURN, DEFER, or CLOSE.

dispatcher.rule: The star denotes profile selection. 3P* is not itself a lifecycle and does not imply MIP admission.

3PC.name: PREPARE_PROVE_COMMIT
use_when: bounded implementation or control change is admitted

stage_rules.MODERNIZE: Admit only for a measured defect, friction, obsolescence, or maintainability/control gap in an existing mechanism.
stage_rules.INNOVATE: Admit only when a genuinely new capability is justified by the mission objective or measured gap.
stage_rules.PERPETUATE: Admit after useful behavior is proven enough to institutionalize through controls, docs, telemetry, handover, or regression protection.

mip.valid_noop: A stage may be NONE_NOT_ADMITTED with a reason. MIP is not a mandatory three-stage mutation.

historical_compatibility.reinterpretation: Existing receipts retain their historical meaning. New controls treat them as method executions under the broader Mission Control operating model.
